candidates.title: Make Waves ’26 — основной день
candidates.description: Конференция Make об AI-агентах, автоматизации бизнеса, внедрении и продуктовых новинках. Двери в 08:30, ключевой доклад в 10:00.
candidates.descriptionEn: Make conference on AI agents, business automation, adoption and product updates. Doors open at 08:30; keynote at 10:00.
candidates.admission: 349 EUR, предварительная регистрация обязательна. В форме доступен выбор General Admission; оплата не проверялась. События 19 октября оплачиваются отдельно.
candidates.admissionEn: EUR 349; advance registration is mandatory. General Admission is selectable in the registration form; payment availability was not tested. October 19 activities are separate add-ons.
candidates.topicReason: Make conference on AI agents, business automation, adoption and product updates. Doors open at 08:30; keynote at 10:00.

evidence.facts: Main day October 20, doors 08:30 CEST, keynote 10:00, exact Cubex address; required advance registration and EUR349 rate. Generic sold-out FAQ is conditional, not a present sold-out notice.
General Admission EUR349 selectable; checkout not submitted.

candidates.title: Make Waves ’26 — The Current
candidates.description: Практический день по AI-агентам, API, вебхукам и продвинутой автоматизации Make. Регистрация с 12:00, занятия 13:00–17:00. Нужны ноутбук и опыт уровня Intermediate.
candidates.descriptionEn: Hands-on day on AI agents, APIs, webhooks and advanced Make automation. Check-in at 12:00; sessions 13:00–17:00. Bring a laptop; intermediate-level experience is expected.
candidates.admission: 199 EUR как дополнение к обязательному основному билету Waves за 349 EUR. Happy hour включен, но проходит в другом месте с 18:00 до 20:00. Не самостоятельный билет за 199 EUR.
candidates.admissionEn: EUR199 add-on to the required EUR349 main Waves ticket. Happy hour is included but takes place at a different venue, 18:00–20:00. This is not a standalone EUR199 ticket.
candidates.priceLabelEn: EUR199 add-on to a EUR349 main ticket
candidates.topicReason: Hands-on day on AI agents, APIs, webhooks and advanced Make automation. Check-in at 12:00; sessions 13:00–17:00. Bring a laptop; intermediate-level experience is expected.

evidence.facts: October19 at Cubex; 12:00 check-in, 13:00–17:00 workshop; EUR199 add-on requires main event ticket. Happy hour is at Moon Club, not Cubex.

candidates.title: AI v kultuře: Proč a za kolik?
candidates.titleEn: AI in Culture: Why and at What Cost?
candidates.description: Конференция о практическом AI в музеях и культурных институциях: AR, интерпретация искусства, работа с посетителями и стоимость внедрения. Открыта также заинтересованной публике.
candidates.descriptionEn: Conference on practical AI in museums and cultural institutions: AR, art interpretation, visitor interaction and implementation costs. Interested members of the public are also welcome.
candidates.admission: Бесплатно по регистрации и одобрению организатора. На странице при проверке оставалось 5 мест. Для отдельного воркшопа 14:45–16:30 нужна дополнительная запись на месте, максимум 18 человек.
candidates.admissionEn: Free with registration and host approval. The page showed 5 remaining spots when checked. A separate 14:45–16:30 workshop requires on-site sign-up and has 18 places.
candidates.topicReason: Conference on practical AI in museums and cultural institutions: AR, art interpretation, visitor interaction and implementation costs. Interested members of the public are also welcome.

evidence.facts: Official Czech AI Association listing, exact venue, host approval, 5 spots remaining.
National Museum heritage-methodology portal: October19, 10:00–17:00, exact address, wider public welcome.
Museum-sourced announcement explicitly states free admission after registration.

candidates.title: Venture Club Pitch Night #4
candidates.description: Вечер стартап-питчей и общения предпринимателей с инвесторами. Заявки проектов уже закрыты, но билеты для зрителей предлагаются отдельно.

candidates.admissionEn: Guests CZK1,200; Venture Club members CZK800, including catering. Capacity is limited. Closed project submissions do not mean audience tickets are sold out.

evidence.facts: October20, 17:30–22:00; exact address, entrance from Petrohradska courtyard; guest/member prices; project applications closed separately from audience attendance.

candidates.title: Музеи и города будущего
candidates.titleEn: Museums and Cities of the Future
candidates.description: Международная конференция о музеях как общественных пространствах, культурной инфраструктуре и будущем городов. На английском с синхронным переводом на русский и казахский.
candidates.descriptionEn: International conference on museums as civic spaces, cultural infrastructure and the future of cities. English with simultaneous Russian and Kazakh interpretation.
candidates.admission: Участие бесплатно по регистрации. Это специальная конференция, а не обычный музейный билет за 3000 KZT. Наличие свободных мест не проверено отправкой формы.
candidates.admissionEn: Free with registration. This is a special conference, not the standard KZT3,000 museum admission. Remaining places were not tested by submitting a form.
candidates.topicReason: International conference on museums as civic spaces, cultural infrastructure and the future of cities. English with simultaneous Russian and Kazakh interpretation.

evidence.facts: Official event headline and structured date October20 2026, free registered participation, languages. Search-indexed full official text was readable; direct retrieval timed out.
Official event list specifies October20 09:00–18:00.
Museum address 28 Al-Farabi; main entrance from Nazarbayev Avenue. Regular museum opening 11:00 is not substituted for conference time09:00.

candidates.sourceCaveat: Kazakh page has a stray October30 markup field; Russian event date and listing agree on October20, independently corroborated by the museum-sourced local announcement.
